main_section:
Join Our Educator Community

Share your expertise and inspire the next generation of makers. We're looking for instructors across electronics, digital fabrication, design, software, and mechanical engineering.

Apply to Teach

Why teach with us

Work with motivated students and schools, set your own availability, and get paid per session or by the hour.

What we offer

Access to fully equipped labs, teaching materials, and a platform that handles scheduling and bookings for you.

Who we're looking for

Educators and practitioners with hands-on expertise in any of our skill domains, at any experience level.

Start Your Application
